title: In Modem, there is a possible escalation of privilege due to a permissions bypass. (CVE-2026-68591)
description: A vulnerability in the Modem component allows a possible escalation of privilege due to a permissions bypass. This issue could enable local privilege escalation if an attacker already has System-level privileges. Exploitation does not require user interaction. A patch is referenced by IDs ALPS09608864 and ALPS09327759.
